summary: Defines an email header field for recording the results of message authentication checks, so filters and mail programs can show or use them. This is a Proposed Standard, updated by RFC 6577, and it was replaced by RFC 7001.

eli5.summary: After checking whether a letter really came from who it says, a mail server stamps the result on the letter. Later readers can see the stamp. A newer memo replaced it.

questions: how do mail servers record spf and dkim results
